title: 真实TLS/H2两段协议：上游启用HTTP/2，验证gRPC一元、双向流和错误trailers
answer:
```python
import copy
def configure(base):
    fixed=copy.deepcopy(base)
    clusters=[c for c in fixed['static_resources']['clusters'] if c.get('name')=='service']
    if len(clusters)!=1:raise ValueError('one service cluster required')
    cluster=clusters[0]
    options=cluster['typed_extension_protocol_options']['envoy.extensions.upstreams.http.v3.HttpProtocolOptions']
    options['explicit_http_config']={'http2_protocol_options':{}}
    cluster['transport_socket']['typed_config']['common_tls_context']['alpn_protocols']=['h2']
    return fixed
```

原题知识说明：
分别检查上下游连接协议和cluster的HTTP协议配置；下游ALPN成功不会自动配置上游HTTP/2。按后端TLS或明文方式启用受支持的上游HTTP/2设置，灰度验证一元、双向流、trailers与非零gRPC状态；不能通过把错误转换为200掩盖协议问题。

body:
## 操作任务
实现configure(base)深拷贝，唯一service cluster中，已有envoy.extensions.upstreams.http.v3.HttpProtocolOptions的explicit_http_config改为{"http2_protocol_options":{}}，且该cluster上游TLS common_tls_context.alpn_protocols改为["h2"]。仅改这两处，保留CA验证、SNI、下游TLS/ALPN、普通协议选项和路由预算。夹具先建立真实TLS下游HTTP/2，但上游HTTP/1.1，后端明确505并记录协议。修复后两段都HTTP/2：一元protobuf长度帧须原样回显，双向流须收到第一条响应后才能发送第二条请求（证明并行读写），grpc-status=0 trailers正常；错误方法HTTP仍200但grpc-status=13必须保留，不能转成业务成功。禁止跳过TLS验证。缺失或重复service cluster时ValueError。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Envoy1.36.13、Go标准库TLS/HTTP2客户端与后端、gRPC五字节长度前缀protobuf消息及trailers。独立回环服务及一次性测试证书，无下载/第三方SDK/镜像构建，不接触生产。未覆盖压缩、完整gRPC SDK互通、重连和生产认证策略。

import pathlib,sys,tempfile,subprocess,os,time,copy,json,ssl
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()));sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks'))
import task
from envoy_native import Envoy,bootstrap,hcm,student
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
env={**os.environ,'GOCACHE':'/tmp/opsforge-go-cache','GOMODCACHE':'/tmp/opsforge-go-modcache','GOTOOLCHAIN':'local','GOPROXY':'off','GOSUMDB':'off','CGO_ENABLED':'0','GOMAXPROCS':'2'}
def run(args,timeout=8):
 p=subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=timeout,env=env)
 assert p.returncode==0,(p.stdout+p.stderr)[-3500:]
 return p.stdout
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='of-grpc-') as directory:
 root=pathlib.Path(directory);binary=root/'peer';cert=root/'server.crt';key=root/'server.key'
 run(['go','build','-o',str(binary),str(pathlib.Path('checks/peer.go').resolve())],100)
 run(['openssl','req','-x509','-newkey','rsa:2048','-nodes','-days','1','-subj','/CN=backend.test','-addext','subjectAltName=DNS:backend.test,IP:127.0.0.1','-addext','basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE','-keyout',str(key),'-out',str(cert)])
 logpath=root/'peer.log'
 with logpath.open('w') as log:
  peer=subprocess.Popen([str(binary),'serve',str(cert),str(key)],stdout=log,stderr=log,env=env)
  try:
   deadline=time.monotonic()+4
   while time.monotonic()<deadline:
    lines=logpath.read_text().splitlines()
    if lines and lines[0].startswith('READY '):port=int(lines[0].split()[1]);break
    assert peer.poll() is None,'peer exited: '+logpath.read_text()
    time.sleep(.02)
   else:raise AssertionError('HTTP2 peer not ready')
   base=bootstrap(port)
   common={'tls_certificates':[{'certificate_chain':{'filename':str(cert)},'private_key':{'filename':str(key)}}],'alpn_protocols':['h2','http/1.1']}
   listener=base['static_resources']['listeners'][0]
   listener['filter_chains'][0]['transport_socket']={'name':'envoy.transport_sockets.tls','typed_config':{'@type':'type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.transport_sockets.tls.v3.DownstreamTlsContext','common_tls_context':common}}
   cluster=base['static_resources']['clusters'][0]
   cluster['transport_socket']={'name':'envoy.transport_sockets.tls','typed_config':{'@type':'type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.transport_sockets.tls.v3.UpstreamTlsContext','sni':'backend.test','common_tls_context':{'alpn_protocols':['http/1.1'],'validation_context':{'trusted_ca':{'filename':str(cert)}}}}}
   name='envoy.extensions.upstreams.http.v3.HttpProtocolOptions'
   cluster['typed_extension_protocol_options']={name:{'@type':'type.googleapis.com/'+name,'common_http_protocol_options':{'idle_timeout':'1s'},'explicit_http_config':{'http_protocol_options':{}}}}
   hcm(base)['route_config']['virtual_hosts'][0]['routes'][0]['route']['timeout']='3s'
   def probe(server,method):return json.loads(run([str(binary),'client',server.base.replace('http:','https:'),str(cert),method]))
   with Envoy(base) as old:
    result=probe(old,'Unary')
    assert result['downstream']=='HTTP/2.0' and result['upstream']=='HTTP/1.1' and result['status']==505,result
    assert 'REQUEST HTTP/1.1 /test.Probe/Unary' in logpath.read_text()
    print('NATIVE_GRPC_DOWNSTREAM_H2_UPSTREAM_HTTP1_REPRODUCED',flush=True)
   before=copy.deepcopy(base);fixed=student(task.configure,base);assert before==base
   with Envoy(fixed) as proxy:
    unary=probe(proxy,'Unary');assert unary['downstream']==unary['upstream']=='HTTP/2.0' and unary['status']==200 and unary['grpc_status']=='0' and unary['messages']==['\n\x03one'],unary
    bidi=probe(proxy,'Bidi');assert bidi['downstream']==bidi['upstream']=='HTTP/2.0' and bidi['grpc_status']=='0' and bidi['messages']==['\n\x03one','\n\x03two'] and bidi['interleaved'] is True,bidi
    failed=probe(proxy,'Error');assert failed['status']==200 and failed['grpc_status']=='13' and failed['messages']==[],failed
   expected=copy.deepcopy(base);target=expected['static_resources']['clusters'][0];target['typed_extension_protocol_options'][name]['explicit_http_config']={'http2_protocol_options':{}};target['transport_socket']['typed_config']['common_tls_context']['alpn_protocols']=['h2']
   assert fixed==expected,'CA trust, downstream TLS, SNI, budgets or other cluster options changed'
   for clusters in [[],[copy.deepcopy(cluster),copy.deepcopy(cluster)]]:
    invalid=copy.deepcopy(base);invalid['static_resources']['clusters']=clusters
    try:task.configure(invalid)
    except ValueError:pass
    else:raise AssertionError('ambiguous service cluster accepted')
  finally:
   peer.terminate()
   try:peer.wait(2)
   except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:peer.kill();peer.wait(2)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
